sample_goal_pose: sample a random goal pose for the cube at a given difficulty level from 1 to 4
validate_goal_pose: validate that a given cube goal pose is within the allowed arena bounds and height
evaluate_state_cost: evaluate the cost between a goal pose and actual pose based on the difficulty level
get_cube_corner_positions: get the 3D positions of all 8 corners of a cube given its pose
serialize_goal_to_json: serialize a Pose object to a JSON string or deserialize a JSON string to a Pose
